attributes.description:
Sets the background color of the accordion pane content. This is the background color that appears behind the accordion content.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-content-background-color

Sets the internal spacing inside the accordion pane content. This creates breathing room around the content.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-content-padding

Controls the border radius for rounded corners of the accordion pane content. This makes the content appear with rounded corners instead of sharp edges.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-content-border-radius

Sets the border style of the accordion pane content. Acceptable values: solid, dashed, dotted.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-content-border-style

Controls the border thickness of the accordion pane content. This determines how thick the border around the content appears.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-content-border-width

Sets the border color of the accordion pane content. This determines what color the border around the content appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-content-border-color
